__NOTOC__{{NPC infobox | image = [[Image:Kurzick priest.jpg|150px]] | level = 10 | affiliation = Kurzicks | type = Human | campaign = Core | campaign2 = Factions | service = Faction rewards{{pipe}}Faction reward }} The [[Kurzick Bureaucrat]] allows the player to cash in [[Kurzick faction]] for [[faction rewards]]. Players can trade 5,000 Kurzick faction for 1 [[Amber Chunk]] or 1,000 Kurzick faction for 1 [[Passage Scroll to Urgoz's Warren]]. [[Level]] 20 [[roleplaying character]]s can also trade 3,000 Kurzick faction for a Kurzick skill. 5,000 Kurzick faction can be donated to your guild. Trading in Kurzick faction causes a player's [[account]] to lose the same amount of [[Luxon faction]] until the account has 0 Luxon faction. Every time Kurzick faction is traded or donated this way, the same amount of faction points go towards your Kurzick [[allegiance rank]] title track. ==Locations== *[[Core]] **[[The Battle Isles]] ***{{NPC location|Guild hall}} (Kurzick [[alliance]]) *[[Factions]] **[[Echovald Forest]] ***[[Grenz Frontier (Kurzick)]] ***{{NPC_location|House zu Heltzer}} ***{{NPC location|Fort Aspenwood (Kurzick)}} ***{{NPC location|Lutgardis Conservatory}} ***{{NPC location|Saltspray Beach (Kurzick)}} ***{{NPC location|The Ancestral Lands (Kurzick)}} ***{{NPC location|Vasburg Armory}} ***{{NPC location|The Jade Quarry (Kurzick)}} **[[The Jade Sea]] ***{{NPC location|Etnaran Keys (Kurzick)}} ***{{NPC location|Kaanai Canyon (Kurzick)}} ==Skills offered== {{Skill trainer list | w = * [[Image:"Save Yourselves!"
